# `TrialOutcome`

`Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\Runner\TrialOutcome`

**Class** — **Package:** [property-testing-core](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core/blob/master/src/Runner/TrialOutcome.php#L17) — **Version:** working tree

Result of executing the property body once, in the engine's terms.

Every framework reports failure its own way — Testo through a `TestResult`
status, PHPUnit through an assertion exception, a bare callable by throwing.
The adapter's [`Runner\TrialExecutor`](/api/classes/Runner/TrialExecutor) folds its way into this single shape so
the run/shrink loop never learns about framework types.
